name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc33): changing a row in a large table no longer reports a failure that did not happen. After saving, the tools re-read the table to confirm the change landed - but that re-read was only fetching the first 20 rows, so a change further down came back as rejected when it had in fact saved perfectly. The Chart of Accounts has 405 rows; anything past the twentieth was affected. It is the same row-count setting rc32 caught and fixed in one place, sitting in a second place that was missed. Also fixed: deleting a row could be reported as SUCCESSFUL purely because the row was not in the part of the table the tools could see - a false confirmation, which is worse than a false alarm. Past 1000 rows they now say plainly that they could not check, and how to check, instead of guessing either way. And an error that used to read 403: with nothing after it now says what was actually denied. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
